notes.title: Objector is here!
notes.notes:
[b]We finally reached the launch date of Objector. The game is available now on Steam.[/b]

Discover the full story, travel across the land, and face all bosses in the game  

[b]Because of the launch date, we prepared for you a special offer. You can buy Objector with a 20% discount. Offer ends 8th August 2023.[/b]

If you are still undecided, [b]you can try the free demo.[/b] Everything is on the official Steam store page.

[b]Good luck, Objectors.[/b]

notes.title: The Demo of Objector is available on Steam. Try it now.
notes.notes:
It presents the first two episodes, every finished with bossfight. There are also more demanding bossfight versions.

Objector is a hard side-scroller platform game with challenging choreographed boss fights set in a diverse fantasy world.

Find more info and download the demo from the Objector's Steam Store site: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219530/Objector/
